competences.description: Attacks the enemy with an axe to inflict 2 Continuous Damage effects for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Attacks the enemy with a wrathful axe, leaving a Branding Effect for 2 turns, and increasing your Attack Bar by 50%. While under [Berserk] state, additionally decreases the enemy's Attack Bar by 50%.

effets.description: The target will receive 25% increased damage.
The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.

competences.description: Attacks an enemy target, stunning it for 2 turns and depleting its Attack Bar. Goes under [Berserk] state for 3 turns afterwards. Under Berserk state, the Defense is decreased by 30%, damage dealt to enemies is increased by 100%, Attack Speed is increased by 20% and HP is recovered by 10% of the damage dealt.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
Under Berserk state, Defense is decreased by 30%, the damage dealt to enemies is increased by 100%, Attack Speed is increased by 20% and HP is recoverd by 10% of the damage dealt.
